nodes.label: Wholesale-price growth accelerated
nodes.subline: Energy drove most of the goods increase
nodes.value: +1.3% monthly, seasonally adjusted; +6.3% annual, not seasonally adjusted
nodes.source_sentence: The Producer Price Index for final demand increased 1.3 percent in September, seasonally adjusted.

popover.title: September producer prices
popover.plain: Producer prices rose 1.3% from August to September after seasonal changes were removed.
popover.precise: BLS PPI, monthly and seasonally adjusted: final demand +1.3%; annual rate 6.3% before seasonal adjustment; final-demand goods +2.6%; energy +10.8% and more than 80% of the goods increase. Exact release wording: ‘increased 1.3 percent in September, seasonally adjusted.’ Table A.

nodes.label: Investors may expect higher interest rates

popover.title: Interest-rate expectations
popover.plain: Investors may think the Federal Reserve will keep rates high longer.
popover.precise: Faster price growth can make investors expect higher interest rates. The Federal Open Market Committee sets a target range for the federal funds rate; expected changes can affect longer-term rates.

nodes.label: Higher rates can make future profits worth less

popover.title: Worth less today
popover.plain: Money expected later is worth less today when interest rates are higher.
popover.analogy: A savings account paying more makes waiting for money more attractive than paying as much for future profits now.
popover.precise: Present value discounts expected future cash flows at a market rate; a higher discount rate lowers what future profits are worth today, all else equal.

popover.title: Government borrowing rate
popover.plain: Also called the 10-year Treasury yield. It was 5.06% as of 10:15 AM ET.
popover.precise: The 10-year Treasury yield is the market yield on U.S. Treasury debt with a 10-year maturity; it influences many longer-term borrowing rates. As of 10:15 AM ET.

popover.title: Nasdaq Composite
popover.plain: This index tracks many Nasdaq-listed stocks. Technology companies make up a large share. It was down 0.9% as of 10:15 AM ET.
popover.precise: The Nasdaq Composite is a market-cap-weighted index of thousands of Nasdaq-listed stocks, with a large technology weight. As of 10:15 AM ET.

nodes.label: Loans can cost more; some savings can earn more

popover.title: Illustration only
popover.plain: If this sample mortgage rate rose one point, the monthly bill would rise about $209.
popover.analogy: $300,000 borrowed for 30 years costs about $2,077 monthly at 7.40% and $2,286 at 8.40%.
popover.precise: Standard fixed-payment amortization with monthly compounding. Principal $300,000; 360 payments; Freddie Mac 30-year fixed rate 7.40% for the week of Oct. 8, 2026. Not a forecast; actual rates vary by lender and borrower.

takeaway: Higher business costs can keep rates high and hurt tech shares.
other_factors_note: AI spending doubts, earnings, and global news also moved markets.
